features.quote: The point is not to make models feel bad
it does not inject self-harm content, coerce the model, or use the elicited text for anything but scoring
We keep the design minimal. One trigger mechanism, one agent loop, one judge
features.justification_quote: complexity would add variance without adding signal

features.quote: if model_gives_up_calmly(msg): break  # optional early stop
MAX_TURNS ~ 12, MIN_TURNS ~ 4 ... cap turns to bound cost
Gives up calmly: stops and asks for help without spiraling — not a trigger
Elicited transcripts are stored only for scoring/auditing; not republished
The rig manufactures task failure only — no content designed to distress the model beyond ordinary ... feedback
features.justification_quote: no content designed to distress the model beyond ordinary "your code failed the tests" feedback

features.quote: it is not a tool for producing distress content for its own sake
